public_inputs.name: kernel[ISA]
public_inputs.description: ISA triple (major, minor, patch) from solution YAML logic file key ISA. In TensileCreateLibrary path: parsed from YAML; in Tensile benchmarking path: comes from --gpu-targets CLI arg or GPU detection.

public_inputs.name: --architecture
public_inputs.description: TensileCreateLibrary --architecture flag (dest=Architecture). Semicolon/underscore-separated gfx arch list. Converted to IsaVersion via gfxToIsa(). Primary public input when building a library (not benchmarking).

public_inputs.name: kernel[PreloadKernArgs]
public_inputs.description: Boolean solution parameter from YAML logic file. Default True. Controls outer gate numSgprPreload > 0. May be forced False by rocmVersion check or ISA constraint in Solution.assignDerivedParameters.

derived_symbols.name: self.states.archCaps
derived_symbols.description: Dict returned by rocIsa.getArchCaps() after setKernel(version,...). Populated by initArchCaps(isaVersion) in hardware_caps.hpp. Thread-local lookup keyed on isaVersion.

derived_symbols.name: self.states.archCaps[SgprPreloadPad]
derived_symbols.description: Integer (0 or 1). True for gfx950 (9,5,0), gfx908 (9,0,10), and all gfx94x (9,4,*). False for gfx11xx, gfx12xx non-gfx1250. Statically determined from ISA triple.

derived_symbols.name: self.states.numSgprPreload
derived_symbols.description: 0 if not PreloadKernArgs, else archCaps[MaxSgprPreload] - rpga - NumIndicesC. Gates the outer if at line 2266.

derivation_path: ti = rocIsa.getInstance(); ti.setKernel(version, wavefrontSize) -> stores isaVersion per-thread
initArchCaps(isaVersion) in hardware_caps.hpp:524: SgprPreloadPad = checkInList(isa,{9,5,0}) || checkInList(isa,{9,0,10}) || (isa[0]==9 && isa[1]==4)
notes: SgprPreloadPad is purely a function of the ISA triple: no filesystem, env, or GPU probe at evaluation time.
The ISA triple can arrive via: (1) YAML logic file ISA key [yaml], (2) CLI --architecture flag [cli]. GPU detection (gpu-probe) is only fallback when neither path supplies an arch.
rocmVersion (hipconfig --version) gates whether PreloadKernArgs stays True, which controls the outer numSgprPreload > 0 check, but SgprPreloadPad itself only depends on ISA.
The predicate is C++ map<string,int>: Python truthiness treats nonzero as True.
